# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest `main` is supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't open a public issue. Report it privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/David-Rodden/diablo2-browser/security/advisories/new) instead. Include the steps to reproduce it and what impact you expect.

You'll get a reply within a week, and a fix or a decision as soon as the issue is understood.
